column1: # Local corrections to the word list (An Gramadóir 0.70 lexicon, data/lexicon.json).
# Built into data/lexicon-corrections.json by tools/build-data.mjs and applied when the
# checker loads, after the BuNaMo overlay (src/lexicon.ts). Our own work, under
# the project's licence; kept apart from the BuNaMo overlay, which is ODbL.
# One word per line, tab-separated: the word, its tags (as in ga/pos-ga.txt,
# written one after another), and the reason. The tags replace all the word's
# tags; the word keeps its frequency tier. A word not in the word list must be in
# the table of non-standard forms (data/eile.json): the correction says it
# is standard, so it is removed from that table and added to the word list (in
# the rarest tier). Any other word not in the word list stops the build. Lines
# starting with # are comments.
# Reference: CO17 = Gramadach na Gaeilge: An Caighdeán Oifigiúil, 2017.
# A preposition or conjunction fused with the copula (CO17 7.3.2, 7.3.3, Táblaí
# 7O-7R). The word list has most of these as the copula (inarb, lenarb, darb,
# faoinarbh, sularbh, ...) but these only as rare words, so they were reported
# as rare, and the word after them as needing the copula (ónarb áil, sularb eol).
faoinarb
column3: CO17 Tábla 7O: Is ábhar é sin faoinarb éasca labhairt.

column1: ónarb
column3: CO17 Tábla 7O: Bhí sé i dteannta an dreama ónarb áil leis teitheadh.
